items.message: INCIDENT INVOLVING CARS 22 (TSU) AND 11 (PER) NOTED - TURN 14 CONTACT
items.description: Tsunoda suffered sidepod radiator puncture and rear suspension failure after wheel-to-wheel contact with Perez entering Turn 14 on opening lap.

items.message: CAR 22 (TSU) RETIRED AT TURN 14 - TRACK CLEARANCE COMPLETE
items.description: Car 22 safely recovered by marshals behind barrier. Sector 3 all-clear signal resumed.

items.message: INCIDENT AT TURN 8 - CAR 2 (SAR) IMPACT WITH TECPRO BARRIER
items.description: Sargeant suffered front-wing dislodgement after locking brakes into Turn 8. Debris dragged along track necessitating full Safety Car deployment.

items.message: SAFETY CAR DELTA & RUNOFF ADVANTAGE - CAR 44 (HAM) UNDER REVIEW
items.description: Hamilton observed exceeding track boundary at Turn 1 runoff under SC approach. Ceded track position back to Russell and Norris to mitigate penalty.

items.message: CAR 11 (PER) UNDER INVESTIGATION - CAUSING A COLLISION WITH CAR 23 (ALB) AT TURN 13
items.description: Perez attempted a late inside overtake on Albon at Turn 13 hairpin. Contact made with Albon's right front wheel forcing Williams into the runoff.

items.message: INCIDENT AT TURN 10 - CAR 63 (RUS) OUT OF RACE INTO BARRIER
items.description: Russell chasing Norris for P2 clipped the inside barrier wall on Turn 10 entry, snapping right-front track rod and spearing head-on into Tecpro on final lap.
